products.name: Event-Driven Mail Processing with Microsoft Graph Change Notifications (Logic Apps + Managed Identity) — Commercial
products.short_description: Process new mail the moment it arrives — a Microsoft Graph change-notification subscription drives your Logic App in near real time, authenticated by managed identity, no O365 connector, no polling.
products.description:
Process new mail the moment it arrives — a Microsoft Graph change-notification subscription drives your Logic App in near real time, authenticated by managed identity, no O365 connector, no polling.

Polling a mailbox on a timer is slow and wasteful, and the Office 365 connector can't use a managed identity. The event-driven answer is a Microsoft Graph change-notification (webhook) subscription: Graph calls your Logic App the moment a message arrives. This solution builds that pattern end to end — the subscription against the target mailbox, the Logic App HTTP endpoint that receives notifications and validates them, the managed-identity + application-permission auth, and the operational hard parts most guides skip: the subscription-expiry/renewal loop, clientState validation, notification-vs-resource-data handling, dedup/idempotency, and reliable reprocessing.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • The subscription — create a Graph change-notification subscription on the mailbox resource (resource/changeType/notificationUrl), flagged verify-with-Microsoft for current limits
  • The receiver — a Logic App endpoint that answers the Graph validation handshake, verifies clientState, and processes notifications idempotently
  • Managed-identity auth — the Logic App reads the changed message via Graph with an application permission (no service account); cross-references #4 for one-mailbox scoping
  • Keep it alive — the subscription-renewal workflow before expiry, missed-notification recovery, and lifecycle monitoring
  • Reliability — dedup/idempotency, retry/dead-letter handling, and a validation script proving events flow end to end

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Near-real-time mail processing driven by Graph change notifications and a managed identity — event-driven, credential-free, and operationally durable with renewal and recovery built in.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GRAPHSUB-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Microsoft Graph change-notification subscriptions and the
    • GRAPHSUB-Renew.ps1 — renew/extend a Microsoft Graph change-notification subscription nearing
    • GRAPHSUB-Report.ps1 — inventory Microsoft Graph change-notification subscriptions to console + CSV
    • GRAPHSUB-Test-Notification.ps1 — check recent notification/processing evidence and flag a lapsed
    • GRAPHSUB-Validate.ps1 — PASS/FAIL readiness check for the change-notification pattern. Read-only

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
